name: Because You Watched
description: Real per-movie 'Because You Watched' home rows: one row per recent watch, named after that movie, filled with genuinely similar titles from your own library. Four-signal scoring engine (tags, genres, people, era) with a tone gate and mood-tag filter. Watched titles hidden, rows follow your history, standalone playlist mode needs no other plugins.
overview: Real per-movie 'Because You Watched' rows built from your own library.

versions.changelog: 1.1.4: tone gate + self-duplicate fix. Per-movie named home rows with four-signal scoring.
